physical: Pressed by Decca Record Co. Ltd., Pressing Plant, UK.

notes.text:
Original UK release in matt cover, on blue/black hexagon labels.
Poly-lined [blue-stereo-box] standard company inner sleeve with record handling instructions, 'Made In England' and 'R.S.'

First catalogue number on cover and labels, 2nd (Decca international cat.#) in parentheses on cover rear.

Recorded at Rockfield Studios, South Wales

℗ 1971
© 1972, MCA Records International.

A1 appears as "Whisky River" on cover, but as "Whiskey River" on label.

MCA Records, Decca House, 9 Albert Embankment, London SE1 7SW
Manufactured in Great Britain by The Decca Record Company Limited.
Licensed by MCA Records Inc., Universal City, California, U.S.A.
Made In England By The Decca Record Co. Ltd.

All matrix runouts are stamped.
